channel.title: GATE Guide — free GATE 2027 guides
channel.description: Free GATE 2027 guides for CSE, ECE, CE, DA, EE and ME: syllabus, weightage, important topics and preparation, by MD ANISH AHAMAD.

item.title: GATE ME 2027 Subject-Wise Weightage: Six Papers, Counted
item.description: GATE ME subject wise weightage counted from all six Mechanical papers, 2022 to 2026, with each year weighted once and every mean printed beside its range.

item.title: GATE EE Subject-Wise Weightage for 2027, Counted from Five Papers
item.description: GATE EE subject wise weightage counted question by question from the 2022 to 2026 Electrical papers, with the mean, range and share of every section.

item.title: GATE DA 2027 Important Topics: The 21 Asked in Every Paper
item.description: GATE DA 2027 important topics from all three DA papers - the 21 topic groups asked every year, the questions behind them, and the named topics never set.

item.title: GATE ME Thermodynamics Formula Sheet 2027: Cycles to Pumps
item.description: GATE ME thermodynamics formula sheet for 2027 with worked examples and traps, from first-law balances and entropy to cycles, combustion and pumps.

item.title: GATE ME Strength of Materials Formula Sheet 2027
item.description: Strength of materials formulas for GATE ME 2027, from elastic constants and Mohr's circle to pressure vessels and columns, each with a worked example.

item.title: GATE ME Heat Transfer Formula Sheet 2027
item.description: Heat transfer formulas for GATE ME 2027, from conduction, fins and the lumped model to convection, LMTD, NTU and radiation, each with a worked example and trap.

item.title: GATE ME Formula Sheet 2027: Key Formulas by Subject
item.description: GATE ME formula sheet for 2027 with key formulas for all ten technical subjects, from Mohr's circle and fins to nozzles and EOQ, and the trap behind each one.

item.title: GATE ME Fluid Mechanics Formula Sheet 2027: Formulas, Examples, Traps
item.description: GATE ME 2027 fluid mechanics formula sheet: statics, kinematics, Bernoulli, pipe flow, boundary layers and nozzles, each with a worked example and its trap.

item.title: GATE EE Power Systems Formula Sheet: Key Formulas and Traps
item.description: GATE EE power systems formula sheet with line models, per unit, load flow, dispatch, droop, faults, relays and stability, plus worked examples and traps.

item.title: GATE EE Power Electronics Formula Sheet: Key Formulas and Traps
item.description: GATE EE power electronics formula sheet covering devices, buck and boost converters, rectifiers, commutation, harmonics, power factor and sinusoidal PWM.

item.title: GATE EE Formula Sheet 2027: Key Formulas by Subject
item.description: GATE EE formula sheet for 2027 with the key formulas of all ten technical sections, from transformers and faults to converters, plus maths and aptitude.

item.title: GATE EE Electrical Machines Formula Sheet: Key Formulas and Traps
item.description: GATE EE electrical machines formula sheet with transformer, DC, induction and synchronous machine formulas, worked examples and the traps that cost marks.

item.title: GATE EE Control Systems Formula Sheet: Key Formulas and Traps
item.description: GATE EE control systems formula sheet covering feedback, time response, errors, Routh, root locus, Bode, Nyquist, compensators and state space, with traps.

item.title: GATE ECE Signals and Systems Formula Sheet 2027, with Traps
item.description: GATE ECE signals and systems formula sheet for 2027: phasors, two-ports, transients, transforms, sampling, z-transform and FIR design, each with its trap.

item.title: GATE ECE Formula Sheet 2027: Key Formulas by Subject
item.description: GATE ECE formula sheet with the most-used formulas for all eight technical sections plus maths and aptitude, each with the trap that costs marks.

item.title: GATE ECE Electromagnetics Formula Sheet 2027, With the Traps
item.description: GATE ECE electromagnetics formula sheet for 2027 covering Maxwell, plane waves, transmission lines, Smith chart, S-parameters, waveguides and antennas.

item.title: GATE ECE Communications Formula Sheet 2027: Formulas and Traps
item.description: GATE ECE Communications formula sheet for 2027 covering random processes, AM, FM, PCM, detection, entropy, capacity and Hamming codes, each with its exam trap.

item.title: GATE ECE Analog Circuits Formula Sheet 2027, With Traps
item.description: GATE ECE analog circuits formula sheet for 2027 with diode, Zener, BJT, MOSFET, differential amplifier and op-amp formulas, each with an example and its trap.

item.title: GATE DA Probability and Statistics Formula Sheet with Traps
item.description: GATE DA probability and statistics formula sheet with Bayes, variance, every distribution, the CLT, confidence intervals and z, t and chi-squared tests.

item.title: GATE DA Machine Learning Formula Sheet with Worked Lines
item.description: GATE DA machine learning formula sheet with regression, ridge, logistic, naive Bayes, SVM, entropy, precision and recall, neural networks, k-means and PCA.
